title: ArcadeDB native-image server builds 26.8.1 before 26.11.1 contain an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows…
description: ArcadeDB native-image server builds from 26.8.1 up to but not including 26.11.1 have an authorization bypass vulnerability. This flaw allows authenticated clients to perform write operations through query paths intended to be read-only by nesting statements within SELECT queries. The vulnerability arises due to missing reflection metadata causing the SQL AST inspector to see an empty abstract syntax tree, enabling INSERT statements in projections or LET clauses to persist via various query endpoints and modes.
